entries.lesson_core_move: Determine the region of convergence by using exponential weighting to identify the set of $s$-plane values for which a signal's Laplace-transform integral converges.

images.section_title: Marking the Region of Convergence in the \(s\)-Plane
images.image_description: Plot the complex $s$-plane with horizontal real axis labeled $\sigma$ and vertical imaginary axis labeled $j\omega$. Draw a dashed vertical boundary line at $\sigma=-1$ and shade the open right half-plane $\sigma>-1$. Mark the boundary as excluded and do not write the ROC inequality in the image.
images.report: S-plane ROC template with right-half-plane shading; Boundary at "$\sigma=-1" drawn as dashed excluded line with exclusion markers$; Saved with bbox_inches="tight" and facecolor="white"
images.lesson_core_move: Determine the region of convergence by using exponential weighting to identify the set of \(s\)-plane values for which a signal's Laplace-transform integral converges.
